"""Official MCP support-floor change only; source model, camera and lights unchanged."""
import bpy,hashlib,json,struct
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/houdini-blender-final')
assert not (ROOT/'floor-adjustment.json').exists()
s=bpy.context.scene;obj=s.objects['HoudiniCeramic'];floor=s.objects['StudioFloor']
assert len(floor.data.vertices)==4 and len(floor.data.polygons)==1
before=hashlib.sha256(b''.join(struct.pack('<3f',*v.co) for v in obj.data.vertices)).hexdigest()
assert before=='ef4df1f48463cfdec160a6cabcaae6bd8620ac4e2c49ffee4a15b816a3bc56cf'
for v in floor.data.vertices:
 assert abs(abs(v.co.x)-8)<1e-6 and abs(abs(v.co.y)-8)<1e-6 and abs(v.co.z)<1e-6
for v in floor.data.vertices:v.co.x*=12.5;v.co.y*=12.5
floor.data.update();s.render.image_settings.color_depth='32';s.render.image_settings.exr_codec='ZIP'
assert hashlib.sha256(b''.join(struct.pack('<3f',*v.co) for v in obj.data.vertices)).hexdigest()==before
(ROOT/'floor-adjustment.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'support floor only expanded from 16m to 200m; no source model or lighting/camera change','model_positions_sha256':before,'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
